remarks: RARE FIND: Tranquility and convenience define Mallard Pond's 21-unit complex--this unit is one of the largest. You can easily drive into the 2-car attached garage, which includes a storage unit and cedar closet. The open floor plan features a bright living room/dining room combination, complete with sliding doors that lead to a private covered deck. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers extensive cabinetry plus a pantry with sliding doors to deck for cocktails and/or alfresco dining.   On the upper floor, you'll find a light-filled office with hardwood floors that separate the two bedroom suites. The primary suite overlooks a lightly wooded area and includes a walk-in closet and a full bath. The second bedroom has a walk-in closet and full bath. New roof installed in 2023 and Anderson thermal windows. Set on the Westport/Norwalk town line, convenient to an array of restaurants, shopping (Stew's), beaches, and Norwalk's Town Green for farmer's markets, bands, and a host of events. A commuter's dream with easy access to Metro North train stations, and I-95 and Merritt. Exceptional value: #5 (same SF) with updates sold for $585,000 on 4/2025.
